title: Postcard from the sea
line: Postcard from the sea · 5 beats · 0:25 · voice + music
approach: A short letter home from a seaside town, read over five postcard views from morning to dusk. Five beats, five seconds each, a soft song under one spoken line.

beats.brief: Morning harbour: small boats rocking, gulls over the water.
beats.shot: A small fishing harbour in the early morning, colourful boats gently rocking, gulls flying over calm water, soft golden light, slow pan, postcard look.

beats.brief: A narrow lane of white houses running down to the sea.
beats.shot: A narrow cobbled lane between white-washed houses with blue doors, the sea visible at the end of the lane, washing on a line moving in the breeze, bright morning.

beats.brief: A café table by the water: a postcard being written.
beats.shot: Close-up of a hand writing a postcard at a café table by the sea, a cup of tea beside it, the harbour soft in the background, warm afternoon light.

beats.brief: The cliff path at golden hour, waves breaking below.
beats.shot: A cliff-top path at golden hour, waves breaking on the rocks far below, long grass moving in the wind, wide cinematic shot.

beats.brief: Dusk over the bay; the lights come on. Hold to the end.
beats.shot: Dusk over a quiet bay, the town's lights coming on along the water, the sky fading from orange to deep blue, still camera, calm.

music.style: Gentle acoustic guitar and soft piano instrumental, light and nostalgic, slow tempo, seaside afternoon mood.

voice.line: The sea is louder than I remembered. I have been walking every morning, and I think I finally slept. Wish you were here.
